title: The One Who Remembers

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have spent so long trying to understand this story.
lines.scriptText: I have spent so long trying to understand this story.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I believed it began with a kingdom. With a traveler. With three people whose lives refused to end.
lines.scriptText: I believed it began with a kingdom. With a traveler. With three people whose lives refused to end.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But every answer led somewhere I had already been.
lines.scriptText: But every answer led somewhere I had already been.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: An empty place by the fire.
lines.scriptText: An empty place by the fire.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A fourth signature.
lines.scriptText: A fourth signature.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A voice beneath the kingdom. A promise.
lines.scriptText: A voice beneath the kingdom. A promise.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And always... Someone missing.
lines.scriptText: And always...{p=0.8} Someone missing.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They were friends. They trusted one another. They were frightened of what was happening to their world.
lines.scriptText: They were friends. They trusted one another. They were frightened of what was happening to their world.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And one of them believed he could save the others.
lines.scriptText: And one of them believed he could save the others.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He made a decision no one could make safely. He took a power he could not control.
lines.scriptText: He made a decision no one could make safely. He took a power he could not control.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He promised that even if the others forgot...
lines.scriptText: He promised that even if the others forgot...{p=1.0}
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He would remember.
lines.scriptText: He would remember.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That handwriting. I thought it belonged to someone who had disappeared.
lines.scriptText: That handwriting. I thought it belonged to someone who had disappeared.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But these marks...
lines.scriptText: But these marks...{p=0.8}
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I know how they curve. I know where the hand hesitates. I know the shape of every letter.
lines.scriptText: I know how they curve. I know where the hand hesitates. I know the shape of every letter.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Because...
lines.scriptText: Because...{p=1.0}
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: No.
lines.scriptText: No.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: BEING
lines.text: You were never meant to find that.
lines.scriptText: You were never meant to find that.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Who are you?
lines.scriptText: Who are you?
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: BEING
lines.text: You have asked that question for five thousand years.
lines.scriptText: You have asked that question for five thousand years.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And you have never answered.
lines.scriptText: And you have never answered.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: BEING
lines.text: We are what remained.
lines.scriptText: We are what remained.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I thought I was protecting them. I thought that if they could forget, the power would lose its hold.
lines.scriptText: I thought I was protecting them. I thought that if they could forget, the power would lose its hold.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I knew they might forget me. But I did not understand what I was asking them to lose.
lines.scriptText: I knew they might forget me. But I did not understand what I was asking them to lose.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I made their choice for them. And when the world broke... I forgot the very people I wanted to save.
lines.scriptText: I made their choice for them. And when the world broke...{p=0.9} I forgot the very people I wanted to save.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was there. I walked beside them. I argued with them. I was the one they tried to stop.
lines.scriptText: I was there. I walked beside them. I argued with them. I was the one they tried to stop.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I wrote the words that led us here. I am not merely the keeper of their history.
lines.scriptText: I wrote the words that led us here. I am not merely the keeper of their history.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The narrator was only a historian.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The narrator is the Forgotten Observer.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I am the part of it that was forgotten.
lines.scriptText: I am the part of it that was forgotten.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: BEING
lines.text: And I am still here.
lines.scriptText: And I am still here.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I know. But you are not the only one who remembers now.
lines.scriptText: I know. But you are not the only one who remembers now.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We don't leave him there.
lines.scriptText: We don't leave him there.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then we need to understand what holds him.
lines.scriptText: Then we need to understand what holds him.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And what happens if we break it.
lines.scriptText: And what happens if we break it.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then we find out.
lines.scriptText: Then we find out.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For five thousand years, I searched for an ending. I believed I could write one if I understood enough.
lines.scriptText: For five thousand years, I searched for an ending. I believed I could write one if I understood enough.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But an ending is not something that belongs to the person holding the pen.
lines.scriptText: But an ending is not something that belongs to the person holding the pen.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I have made that mistake before.
lines.scriptText: I have made that mistake before.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Perhaps the story was never waiting to end. Perhaps it was waiting for us to find one another.
lines.scriptText: Perhaps the story was never waiting to end. Perhaps it was waiting for us to find one another.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR

lines.speaker: BEING
lines.text: The world is still broken.
lines.scriptText: The world is still broken.
lines.alignmentMethod: wav2vec2-base-960h quantized ONNX CTC Viterbi, independently checked by small.en ASR
